faq.description: I've gathered the most common questions about my work here. If you can't find what you're looking for, just reach out.

items.q: How does design benefit my business?
items.a: Good design helps attract more users, improve the experience, increase conversion and strengthen your brand. More than aesthetics, design is a strategic tool to solve real problems and drive results for your business.

items.q: How much does it cost to hire you for a project?
items.a: The investment depends on the scope, complexity and deliverables. Once I understand your context and goals, I can propose a suitable scope and share an estimate.

items.q: How does the work process go?
items.a: We start by understanding the problem and the project's goals. Then we structure the solution, develop the design proposals and prepare the handoff. The process adapts to the context, the scope and the people involved.

items.q: How long does it take to finish a project?

caaStory.title: Behind the experience
caaStory.intro: Compre & Alugue Agora (CAA) is an app that connects people with opportunities in the real estate market. It brings together property search for buying and renting, new developments, services and relationship tools in one digital environment, aiming to simplify connections and make the journey more intuitive.

challenge.label: Challenge
challenge.text: Organize different features and needs in a single app while keeping navigation clear and easy to use. It was necessary to consider different user profiles, make resources easy to access and prevent the range of possibilities from making the experience complex.

process.label: Process
process.text: My work in UX/UI and Product Design covered defining the information hierarchy, organizing interaction flows, structuring navigation and developing interfaces for the app's different areas, with the goal of creating an intuitive, consistent experience aligned with the product's objectives.
process.continuation: The work also involved building visual and functional patterns to keep features consistent and create a foundation for the product's evolution.

results.label: Results
results.text: The work helped structure the app experience, bringing different features together in a clearer, more integrated journey.
results.continuation: The navigation structure, information hierarchy and consistent interfaces established a foundation for the product's ongoing evolution, with a focus on clear navigation and ease of use.

iruasStory.title: A search shaped around different contexts
iruasStory.intro: iRuas is a property discovery app that brings together different ways to find real estate opportunities.

challenge.label: Challenge
challenge.text: Organize different needs and search modes into an intuitive, coherent experience.

role.label: My role
role.text: I worked in UX/UI and Product Design, including product conception, defining the search modes and structuring the experience.

solution.label: Solution
solution.text: The concept brings gesture, camera, route and text search together in one experience.

difference.label: Approach
difference.text: Exploring different ways to discover properties lets the search adapt to different contexts of use.

aboutPage.title: Design with strategy. Technology with purpose.
aboutPage.intro: With more than 18 years of experience, I bring strategy, design and technology together to turn complex problems into simple, useful and relevant digital products and experiences.
trajectoryBody: My journey began in Web Design and Front-end and grew into UX/UI Design and Product Design, broadening my view of how experience, technology and business connect.

Over more than 18 years in digital, I have developed a perspective that goes beyond the interface. My experience lets me consider both the experience of people using a product and the feasibility of implementation, the consistency of solutions and how a product evolves over time.
I have also worked with Design Ops and Design Systems, helping structure processes, organize patterns and create more consistent foundations for digital product evolution.
Today, I enjoy connecting these perspectives to turn complex challenges into clear, functional solutions built to grow.
visionBody: I believe good design does not start on a screen. It starts with understanding the problem and the decisions that guide the solution.
I enjoy organizing information, finding patterns and simplifying journeys. I value consistency, accessibility and collaboration across design, technology and business.

To me, Design Systems and user experience are not separate topics. They are parts of one view: building digital products that make sense to people, meet business goals and evolve without losing coherence.

I am motivated by turning challenges into concrete solutions, questioning the obvious and finding better ways to do things. Even after many years in the field, I still value curiosity, learning and the chance to grow with every project.
